Check what benefits you can claim

Last updated on 1st June 2026

Find out which National Insurance benefits you may be able to claim from the National Insurance and Social Security Service (NISSS).

This is an online check. It gives guidance only — it is not an application and does not guarantee a payment. If the check shows you may qualify, you then apply to the NISSS.

It is free and takes about 2 minutes. Your answers are not saved or sent anywhere.

Start now

Who can use this

This check is for anyone living or working in Barbados who pays, or has paid, National Insurance contributions — or who is claiming on behalf of a family member who has died.

What you’ll need

You do not need any documents to use the check. You will only need them if you decide to apply afterwards.

If you prefer to read everything first

You can view the full list of National Insurance benefits, with rates, qualifying conditions and the documents you need to apply.

Source: National Insurance and Social Security Service (NISSS), Registration, Benefits and Claims Overview (April 2026).
